title: Canonical Who-Is discovery request
purpose: Provide a simple, mutation-friendly discovery seed using unconfirmed request layering and minimal payload.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP endpoint should accept the frame as an unconfirmed discovery-style request and either process it locally or ignore it if discovery handling is disabled.
constraints_preserved: BVLC header present and length 0x000c matches 12-byte frame
NPDU header uses version 0x01 with control 0x00 as a minimal local NPDU scaffold
APDU uses Unconfirmed-Request-PDU type 0x10 from supplied APDU type reference
Unconfirmed service body uses conservative minimal Who-Is form because numeric service/body details were not included in supplied excerpts
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; no vulnerability motif used. Payload is a conservative minimal discovery analogue, not a replay of any historical issue sample.
